subject.title: fix(scripts): bound ci-run-timings git and GitHub CLI operations

question: Should the repository adopt 60-second GitHub CLI and 120-second Git/GitHub CLI hard deadlines for these CI and release-maintenance operations?
rationale: The patch deliberately changes automation from waiting for an unresponsive child process to failing at a fixed deadline; source-level correctness cannot establish that these workflow-specific budgets are the preferred operational policy.

options.title: Accept bounded failure budgets
options.body: Accept the 60- and 120-second limits as the intended fail-fast policy once the current head is green.

options.title: Request workflow-specific adjustment
options.body: Keep the per-operation timeout approach but revise one or more deadlines if maintainers have evidence that a healthy workflow can exceed them.

options.title: Pause timeout expansion
options.body: Leave the existing scripts unchanged if the operational cost of false timeout failures exceeds the benefit of bounded automation.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded failure budgets
recommendation.body: Accept the 60- and 120-second limits as the intended fail-fast policy once the current head is green.

likelyOwner.reason: They contributed the closest merged timeout implementations and can provide the strongest adjacent-pattern context, although final acceptance remains a repository maintainer decision.
